english.title: Display signs etc without authorisation - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) posted, distributed, or displayed at Liverpool John Lennon Airport a notice, advertisement, sign, circular or other written or printed matter, namely **(..SPECIFY MATTER..), other than on premises that you were authorised to occupy and in accordance with the terms of your occupation, without first obtaining the permission of Liverpool Airport Limited
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 4(14) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
